Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for agreeing to host the Northern Region handover workshop (May 18-20). We want to lock calendar holds and confirm whether you want a full onsite day for exec-level content (Day 1) + working breakout (Day 2) + remote follow-up/optional office hours (Day 3), or prefer a hybrid split (onsite half-days + remote deep-dive).

Quick asks to help us finalize travel and AV logistics: 
- Preferred on-site days and any blackout dates for Brightwave execs
- Approx attendee count by role (execs / engineering / product / security)
- Whether you need closed captions / live transcription for remote participants
- Local point of contact for venue access and badge printing

We're proposing tentative calendar holds (all times in PDT):
- May 18 (full day) - Exec/Leadership HQ sessions 08:30 - 16:30
- May 19 (AM) - Breakouts 09:00 - 12:30; (PM) Office hours 13:30 - 16:30
- May 20 (virtual follow-up) - 10:00 - 11:30 (PT)

I've attached a draft agenda, venue floorplan and a travel itinerary template to share with your team. If you prefer different windows for timezone reasons, tell us the earliest/latest local times that work and we'll adapt.

If it helps, Marissa will join to coordinate AV and Vivek is our onsite lead for logistics — I'm cc'ing both. Looking to finalize by EOD Monday so travel bookings can start Tues.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference

- Attendees: 6 execs, 8 product/engineering, 2 security.
- Closed captions would be appreciated for remote staff.
- Venue contact: Sam Park (local ops) — sam.park@brightwave.com. He handles badges and catering.

2) If any of your presenters need to fly in the evening of May 17, can we confirm hotel room-block details before Tue morning so we can coordinate pickups?
